evaluation_note: Accuracy is from a random per-window split; windows from the same site appear in train and test, so it is not an estimate of performance on new sites or regions. Grouped leave-one-site-out evaluation is Phase 5; retraining on more real data is Phase 12.

predecessor.retired_reason: Class restored_mid had no real training rows: it was trained entirely on synthetically generated audio, so this model was retired and replaced by one trained on real recordings only (docs/model/DEPLOYED-MODEL-AUDIT.md).
